_comment: Hand-confirmed audioStartSeconds per track, by ear, overriding scripts/generate-tracks.js's loudness-heuristic guess (TRACK_SUGGESTED_START in src/tracks.js). Add an entry here once the owner has listened and picked an exact second; generate-tracks.js prefers this value over the computed one and regenerates src/tracks.js's comment to say so. Keyed by the track's filename minus extension, same as TRACKS/TRACK_SUGGESTED_START.
